# list.docker_image

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: list-resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists images in the provider's Docker host image store as `docker_image` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import. Each image appears once, named by its first tag; filters map to the Engine API `GET /images/json` filters.

List resources need Terraform >= 1.14 and live in `*.tfquery.hcl` files run
with `terraform query`. Arguments go inside the list block's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
# in a *.tfquery.hcl file; run: terraform query
list "docker_image" "<name>" {
  provider = docker
  # include_resource = true   # also return full resource objects
  # limit            = 100
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dangling` | `bool` | optional |  |  | `true` lists only untagged images, `false` only tagged ones. |
| `labels` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Only images carrying every one of these labels. An empty value matches any value of that label key. |
| `reference` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only images whose reference matches this pattern, e.g. `nginx` or `ghcr.io/org/*:1.*`. |

## Example

```terraform
# Run with `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14+); add `-generate-config-out=imports.tf`
# to write import blocks and resource configuration for what is found.
provider "docker" {}

list "docker_image" "nginx" {
  provider = docker

  config {
    reference = "nginx"
    dangling  = false
  }
}
```
